{{Quote|No, we are here to help the economy of Cularin grow and prosper, and to bring prestige to Caarimon and Filordis by our expanding presence in the galaxy.|From the office of Metatheran Cartel representative Thurm Loogg|<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011220a_gift&c=swlfc|text=The Cartel's Gift}}</ref>}}
'''Filordis''' was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was a harsh world of fierce winds and frequent thunderstorms. The [[Filordus|Filordi]], the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of six-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], often either left their homeworld for better living conditions elsewhere or attempted to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] it. The territory of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Filordis was already [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and the Filordi became a partner species of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] by [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].

==Description==
Filordis was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="UAA" /> located in the [[Filordis system/Legends|Filordis system]], a part of the [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Filordis [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="CSWE Filordis" /> and was a rocky wasteland world<ref name="UAA" /> swept by constant, fierce winds and frequent thunderstorms.<ref name="CSWE Filordis" />

==History==
[[File:Filordus_UAA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Filordis was home to the sentient Filordi.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Filordis was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and the world lay in what was considered the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] took place in [[3996 BBY]]. Around that time, a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Filordis to the [[Nouane system/Legends|Nouane]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]]; however, that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist by the time the [[Mandalorian Wars]] were fought [[3976 BBY|twenty years]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Metatheran Cartel]] was founded one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Filordus|Filordi]] natives of Filordis were a member [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Filordi secretly met with members of the [[Caarite]] species on Filordis. The Caarites invited the Filordi to withdraw from the Trade Federation and instead become partners in a new business venture, the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. The Filordi agreed,<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[31 BBY/Legends|two years]] later,<ref name="31 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] [[roleplaying game]] campaign, which includes the events described in the article "[[The Cartel's Gift]]," takes place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the office of the Cartel representative [[Thurm Loogg]] claimed that the business successes of the organization brought prestige to both Filordis and [[Caarimon]],<ref name="Wizards" /> the Caarite homeworld.<ref name="LFCG" />

==Inhabitants==
Filordis was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Filordi, a six-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species that spoke the [[Filordian]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. The harsh nature of their homeworld left a significant impression on the Filordi mindset. Many of the planet's natives were eager to leave their home and venture into the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in order to find better places to live. Other Filordi preferred to make what they could of Filordis and began [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] it in order to make it less hostile.<ref name="UAA" /> The population of the Filordi [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered between 1 million to 10 million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Filordis was introduced in the ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2001]] sourcebook authored by [[Robert Wiese]] and [[Andy Collins]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LFCG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Filordis system, and therefore the world Filordis, in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
